findings.title: enableSqlExpressions unconditionally returns false in both branches
findings.body: In `enableSqlExpressions`, both the `if enabled` branch and the fallthrough return `false`. While this intentionally disables SQL expressions for the security fix, the conditional logic (`enabled := !h.features.IsEnabledGlobally(...)` followed by `if enabled { return false }; return false`) is dead/redundant and will trigger static analysis warnings (such as `staticcheck` / `golangci-lint` flagging identical branches or unconditional return values). If SQL expressions are meant to be unconditionally disabled regardless of the feature flag, the function or check should simply return `false` (or the `QueryTypeSQL` case should directly return the error) without the dead branch.
